observations: Photo 0 and 1: front view of a dark-cell solar panel (half-cut monocrystalline style cells, silver aluminum frame), glare from flash obscures most of the cell surface.
A second panel is visible stacked behind the main one in photo 0/1, suggesting more than one unit may be for sale.
Photo 2 and 3: back view of a white-backsheet solar panel showing a junction box and two MC4-style connectors.
A manufacturer label is visible on the back in photo 3 but the text (brand, wattage, model, certification numbers) is too small and low-resolution to read.
Watermark 'NETWORK SOLAR VENTURES' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlay all images; timestamp reads 2025/08/07 14:54, location tag says 'Lagos, Nigeria' even though the buyer's market is Oyo.
Background shows a cluttered shop/warehouse with cables, sacks, and other stacked panels, consistent with a solar equipment dealer's premises.
No visible cracks, chips, or discoloration on the visible cell surface, but heavy glare limits inspection of cell integrity.

identity.kind: monocrystalline solar panel (half-cut cell, with junction box and MC4 connectors)

claims.claim: Seller intro text 'Thank you for contacting Network Solar venture... We deal...' (message cut off, no explicit product claim stated)
claims.evidence: Text is a generic greeting with no verifiable product-specific claim; message appears truncated.

claims.claim: Implied: item is a new, working solar panel suitable for sale
claims.evidence: No power test, multimeter reading, or electroluminescence image shown in any photo.

risks.risk: Wattage/model/spec unknown since back label is unreadable, which is the primary driver of a solar panel's price.
risks.proof: A clear, well-lit close-up photo of the back label showing brand, wattage (Wp), voltage (Voc/Vmp), and certification marks.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this; treated as unknown-spec item.

risks.risk: Cell damage (microcracks, hotspots) hidden by flash glare in front-view photos.
risks.proof: Daylight photo taken without direct flash glare, or an electroluminescence (EL) test image.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically unverified / possible defects, i.e. lowest condition tier.

risks.risk: Panel may not actually generate rated power (dead cells, bypass diode failure).
risks.proof: Video of the panel connected to a multimeter/load under sunlight showing voltage and current output.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working until tested.

risks.risk: Unclear how many panels are actually included in this listing (a second panel is visible stacked behind).
risks.proof: A single photo showing all units laid out and counted, with a note on quantity included in this sale.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single unit only, the one in clear focus.

risks.risk: Location tag says Lagos while buyer is in Oyo, raising a small possibility that photos are stock/reused images rather than the actual current item.
risks.proof: A fresh photo with the panel next to a dated newspaper or the seller's shop signage in Oyo.
risks.if_unproven: does not block pricing but flagged as a trust/verification gap.

proof_requests: Close-up, well-lit photo of the rear specification label (brand, wattage, Voc, Vmp, Isc, certification).
Photo or video of the panel's output reading on a multimeter while in sunlight.
Photo showing the full set/quantity of panels being offered in this listing.
A non-flash daylight photo of the front cell surface to check for cracks or discoloration.
response.reason: The item is identifiable only as a generic monocrystalline solar panel; the spec label that determines wattage and therefore price is visible but unreadable, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without a clearer label shot.
